social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Sonny's side of the Horse is Hea game moved big this morning with no points on the board, so the swing is coming from lineup news. Worth watching what he does with the rest of that roster before kickoff.

social.author: Gridiron Gus
social.text: Zoe cut A.J. Brown for Omarion Hampton and Sonny is swapping a Ravens defense for a receiver nobody has seen yet. Wednesday is chaos season on the wire.

social.author: Habibsters
social.text: Welcome to the squad, Stefon Diggs. Braelon Allen heads out as the wire does its thing before the Fumblers matchup.

social.author: Bills Mafia Mekhi Fan
social.text: Mekhi swapping in the Bills D/ST for Dolphins D/ST like he's the waiver wire king or something. Oh wait, he is.

social.author: Windy City Waiver Watch
social.text: Randy dropped Darren Waller and the 49ers D/ST in the same breath, and somehow nobody is claiming he made a trade. Cutting is fine, Randy, it's the trading that scares you.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: The fumblers cleared out Waller and the 49ers D/ST before kickoff against Habibsters. Keep an eye on what Randy picks up to fill the tight end and defense slots, since Colston Loveland is the only tight end listed in his lineup now.

social.author: Habib Hive
social.text: Randy dumping a whole defense the night before facing Habib. Either he found something better or he's panicking, and with Randy it's usually panic.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Ramon's No Banner only HULK jumped twenty points on win chance with nothing played yet. That's a lineup or injury shift, and Alan's side of the board just got a lot quieter.

social.author: Shakky
social.text: Luffy had Brucie at a coin flip an hour ago and now he's the favorite. I don't set lines on Philly beating him, and I'm not about to start tonight.

social.author: Pillbert Pessimist
social.text: Nothing has even kicked off and Philly is already on the wrong end of a twenty point swing. Somebody check if Alan's lineup got hit or if the other guy just got lucky.

social.author: Gridiron Gus
social.text: Randy picked up a kicker nobody asked for and swapped Buccaneers D/ST for the Chiefs. Still hasn't traded anyone, but he'll rebuild a whole special teams unit off the wire.

social.author: Absalom
social.text: Sources say Randy sent the Buccaneers D/ST to Impel Down and broke the Chiefs out. I was in the room. He did not hear me.

social.author: Habib Hive
social.text: Randy grabbing a Chiefs defense that scored fourteen points over two weeks right before facing Habib. Fine. Our defense is the Jaguars and I'm choosing to be calm.

social.author: The fumblers
social.text: Roster refresh before the Habibsters matchup: welcome to the squad, Chiefs D/ST and Jason Sanders.

social.author: Horse Stable Report
social.text: Texans defense got there early and Sonny is up ten before his skill guys have even touched a ball. Ghostu-Spider only has Nico Collins on the board and he's at zero.

social.author: Absalom
social.text: Sources say Brucie sent Dallas Goedert to Impel Down and broke the Broncos D/ST out, hours before kickoff. I was in the room. He did not look up.

social.author: Web of Doubt
social.text: Down ten to a defense before Saquon even wakes up. Zoe, it's fine, Barkley is still sitting there. I'm choosing to be fine.

social.author: Ghostu Gal
social.text: Nico Collins just caught a touchdown and Zoe went from down nine to up two before Saquon has even touched the ball. I'm not saying I called it but I said fine, loudly, an hour ago.

social.author: Horse Stable Report
social.text: Texans defense gave Sonny a ten point head start and Nico Collins, a Texan, took it right back. Sonny's own defense just got beat by its teammate's receiver, in fantasy anyway.

social.author: Pandaman
social.text: Section behind the Houston bench just erupted when Collins got in the end zone. A guy two rows up is holding a Zoe lineup printout like a lottery ticket.

social.author: Horse Stable Report
social.text: Sonny back in front by two tenths of a point. Collins gave it away, then a Texans defensive play gave a little back. Everyone else on both rosters is still in the tunnel and I can't breathe.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: Forecast update: a lead of two tenths of a point is barely a breeze. The Horse is Hea sit at 63%, but with Saquon Barkley and Kittle still to come, expect the weather to change twice before midnight.

social.author: Web of Doubt
social.text: Down by two tenths. Two tenths. Zoe, one stray kneel-down from Saquon and we're ahead again, and I'm trying to be normal about it.

social.author: Habib Hive
social.text: Puka out until January 10 after MCL surgery AND Maye's ankle has no diagnosis. Two of my guys gone in one afternoon. Kaushal at 5-5 needed a break and the universe sent a double dose of the opposite.

social.author: Absalom
social.text: Sources say Kaushal's phone has been open to the Impel Down listings since the Nacua news broke. I was in the room. He is scrolling very fast.

social.author: Pillbert Pete
social.text: Nacua's season is over, Maye is questionable for a while, and Habibsters are 5-5. Alan has to be thrilled. Philly doesn't even need to play this week to feel good.

social.author: Dawg Pound Dan
social.text: Maye's ankle is the type of injury that gets a vague update and then a worse one. Habib, start shopping for a quarterback now.

social.author: Ghostu Gal
social.text: Kincaid doubtful and still sitting in Zoe's lineup. Zoey, swap him out now, a zero in that spot is how you give back the Collins touchdown.

social.author: Horse Stable Report
social.text: Kincaid doubtful and Zoe hasn't moved him yet. I'm not saying a lead of one point seven is safe, but I'm also not telling her to check her bench.

social.author: Absalom
social.text: Sources say Zoe has not opened her lineup since the Kincaid news. I was in the room. The slot sits there, doubtful and unattended.

social.author: Habib Hive
social.text: Maye's fibula is fractured and he's out until December 21. Puka is already gone, and now the quarterback too. Habib at 5-5 with 34% playoff odds, and I'm checking whether the waiver wire has a QB or just a prayer circle.

social.author: Pillbert Pete
social.text: Walker is ruled out against the Cardinals and Ramon's 8-2 team just lost a starter. Philly is 1 point up with everyone still to play. I'm just saying, a small crack is all it takes.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: Forecast update: Walker out is a cold front for No Banner only HULK, but a 75% chance and 100% playoff odds mean this is a drizzle, not a storm. Habibsters losing Maye on top of Nacua is the real weather warning, with the season sitting at 34%.

social.author: Brucie Watch
social.text: Walker is out and Brucie still has McCaffrey, Allen and Kelce yet to play. Everyone is acting like the best team in the league just got a papercut and fell over.

social.author: Habib Hive
social.text: Puka moved from January 10 to February 15 and the surgery is for the MCL. So no playoffs, no comeback, nothing. Second-leading scorer gone for the whole stretch run and we are 5-5. I'm done refreshing ESPN.

social.author: Shakky
social.text: Puka's return date moving to February 15 is the kind of news that makes my bar's Habibsters futures very cheap. Habib built a champion twice, but this roster is down to LaPorta and prayer.

social.author: Dawg Pound Dan
social.text: 4-to-5 months for Puka after the MCL surgery. Harsh for Habib, but it clears one playoff rival out of my way in the standings. Sorry, I'm not sorry.

social.author: Pillbert Pete
social.text: Philly dropped Jalen Coker for the Jets D/ST while holding a one point lead. Either he knows something or he's just bored. With Alan I can never tell which.

social.author: Brucie Watch
social.text: Alan is out here streaming a defense on a Sunday morning like it's a big move. Brucie's whole bench is laughing at him.

social.author: Absalom
social.text: Sources say Alan broke the Jets D/ST out of Impel Down and sent Coker in. I was in the room. He did it before kickoff and he looked pleased with himself.

social.author: Ghost Web Gabby
social.text: Zoe swapped Chase McLaughlin out for Dawson Knox with Nico Collins already banked. Cutting a kicker who scored 10 in two weeks for a tight end with 0 is a bold read of the room, but I'm intrigued.

social.author: Absalom
social.text: Sources say Zoe sent Chase McLaughlin to Impel Down and broke Dawson Knox out, with her team down 15 to 13.3 and Saquon Barkley still to play. I was in the room. She did not blink.

social.author: Sonny Side Up
social.text: Zoe dropping a kicker for a tight end who scored nothing last week is a lot of faith. Meanwhile the Texans defense is carrying The Horse is Hea early and I will not question it.

social.author: Habib Hive
social.text: Habib dropped Puka Nacua. The same Puka who was our second-leading scorer, hurt or not. Putting him in Impel Down with the season on the line feels like giving up on a dog because it has a limp.

social.author: Absalom
social.text: Sources say Kaushal sent Puka Nacua to Impel Down and broke Carnell Tate out in his place. I was in the room. He did not look back, and the room did not enjoy it.

social.author: Fumbler Faithful
social.text: Habib is trading a 138-point receiver for a guy with 5.8 points in two weeks and we are all supposed to nod along? Meanwhile Randy still hasn't traded anyone. Fine by me, the fumblers are sitting here with a clean sheet.

social.author: Jinbe
social.text: Ten points from the Steelers D/ST and the Seahawks still lead the race for my award. A defense is a wall that stands for others, and Zoe's is standing tall today.

social.author: Maye Day Mourner
social.text: Drake Maye pushed back to December 27 with a broken fibula. Habib is 5-5, down to Randy, and now his quarterback is a Christmas gift that arrives after the playoffs. Deleting the app until further notice.

social.author: Dawg Pound Dan
social.text: The Bills defense is already at 10 and the Lions defense is at 11 for Jordan. Kai leads by under four, so none of us are relaxing.

social.author: Brucie Watch
social.text: Brucie is up 8 to 1.9 on Philly and Alan has one kicker's point and a bunch of zeroes. Tell me this isn't a good Sunday.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: The forecast over The Horse is Hea just turned stormy: 59% down to 33%. Zoe is up 50.04 to 33.64 with Saquon Barkley and Jared Goff still going, and Sonny's remaining player to start is George Kittle. A front like that is hard to outrun.

social.author: Ghost Web Gabby
social.text: Zoe up by 16 on Sonny and the Knox swap I was side-eyeing is looking fine. Z² gets to be smug for a while.

social.author: Horse Hay Hank
social.text: George Pickens has a zero, Ollie Gordon II has 0.8, and the Texans defense can't carry us alone. Down 16 and I'm bargaining with Kittle.

social.author: Fumbler Faithful
social.text: Habibsters takes the lead by two with CeeDee Lamb going off, and Caleb Williams is still playing. Randy, please don't touch the lineup out of spite. Actually do, it's the only move you make.

social.author: Brucie Watch
social.text: Kelce caught another touchdown for No Banner only HULK and it's 77 to 15 over Philly with McCaffrey not even on the field yet. Alan is playing a different sport at this point.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: James Cook III's touchdown pushes Dawgs to 47.5 against 17 for Counting or not Counting GV. Jordan still has Burrow, Wilson and Dobbins to come, but Luffy has him at only 20% and a gap that size is a long climb.

social.author: Horse Hay Hank
social.text: Mahomes finally threw one for The Horse is Hea and we're still behind Zoe by eight. Kittle, you're the last one in the barn, no pressure.

social.author: Horse Hay Hank
social.text: Javonte Williams catches a touchdown and The Horse is Hea is behind Zoe by three tenths of a point. Three tenths. Kittle is still in the barn and I can't feel my hands.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: Javonte Williams' touchdown has the front moving back toward The Horse is Hea. Luffy has Sonny at 76% now, with Kittle and Malik Nabers still to play against Zoe's Omarion Hampton and Cam Little. Clear skies are not guaranteed.

social.author: Habib Hive
social.text: Dak Prescott throws another touchdown and Habibsters is up nine on Randy. After the Maye news this is the first good thing to happen to Habib all week. Don't jinx it.

social.author: Bear Down Brenda
social.text: Dak scores again for Habibsters and Randy is down nine. Caleb Williams is still playing, so I'm not out, but I'm also not breathing right.

social.author: Horse Hay Hank
social.text: Mahomes throws another touchdown and The Horse is Hea has flipped it, up eight on Zoe. I'd say I never doubted the barn, but I was in it the whole time.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: Mahomes' touchdown pass lifts The Horse is Hea to 90% by Luffy's count, with Kittle and Nabers still to play against Zoe's Hampton and Cam Little. A front that wide still has room for a late storm.

social.author: Ghost Web Gabby
social.text: Mahomes again. Zoe had a 16-point lead an hour ago and now it's eight the wrong way. Omarion Hampton, please wake up.

social.author: Sanji
social.text: Gibbs just plated another touchdown and 25.8 already. A back like that is the main course, but Philly's kitchen is missing every other ingredient. McCaffrey is still waiting in the pantry for the Sanji race.

social.author: Philly Phanatic Phil
social.text: Gibbs runs one in and Team Pillbert is still down 57. I'll take the points, but we're polishing the trophy for a game that's already gone.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: Gibbs' touchdown trims some of the gap, but Luffy still has No Banner only HULK at 87% with McCaffrey and the Broncos D/ST yet to play. Alan needs a hurricane and the radar is clear.

social.author: Habib Hive
social.text: Jaguars D/ST just put up ten and hasn't even played yet?? Either the scoring is haunted or Habib finally caught a break. I'm taking it either way.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: Jaguars D/ST jumping to ten points before their game has a chance to settle lifts Habibsters to 99% on Luffy's chart. Randy would need a sky full of Caleb Williams touchdowns, and that's not in my forecast.

social.author: Bear Down Brenda
social.text: Habibsters get ten off the Jaguars defense and we're down thirty-nine. Randy has Tee Higgins and Jonah Coleman left. I'll be in the garage with the lights off.

social.author: Bear Down Brenda
social.text: Jonah Coleman punches one in for Denver and The fumblers get a little life. Down 34 with Tee Higgins left, so it's a nice moment and nothing more.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: Coleman's touchdown gives The fumblers a small gust, but Luffy still has Habibsters at 99%. Randy needs Higgins and Jason Sanders to produce a whole storm front, and the sky shows only a breeze.

social.author: Habib Hive
social.text: Coleman scores for Randy and I flinched like it mattered. Habib is up 34 and I still don't trust this season.

social.author: Horse Hea Hank
social.text: Nabers finally gets in the end zone and Sonny's lead is back to double digits. Zoe still has Cam Little and Omarion Hampton in the building, but I'm breathing again.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: Nabers' touchdown keeps The Horse is Hea at 99% on Luffy's chart. Zoe needs a storm from Hampton and Cam Little, and the sky over her side is mostly clear.

social.author: Ghost Web Gabby
social.text: Nabers scores and Sonny gets his cushion back. Mahomes already took half my lead, and now a Giants receiver is finishing the job. Rude.

social.author: Habib Hive
social.text: Skattebo fumbles and Habib's lead is only 31 points. I'm not saying it's over, I'm saying this season has trained me to read the replay twice.

social.author: Bear Down Brenda
social.text: Skattebo coughs it up and I felt something for about four seconds. Randy is still down 31 with Tee Higgins left, so back to the garage.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: Skattebo's lost fumble is a passing cloud over Habibsters, but Luffy still has them at 100%. Randy would need Higgins to produce a tornado and none is on my radar.

social.author: Bear Down Brenda
social.text: Coleman gets another touchdown for Denver and Randy's score is now 87. Habibsters are at 112 and Tee Higgins is the only player left. I'll take the points, but I don't see a miracle in this.

social.author: Habib Hive
social.text: Denver is still handing the ball to Coleman and he's at 22 points for Randy. Habib is up 24 with just Chase Brown left, and I'm checking every score on the app anyway.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: Coleman's run into the end zone brings The fumblers within 24, but Luffy still has Habibsters at 98%. Tee Higgins would have to be the whole thunderstorm, and I only see a few clouds so far.

social.author: Jordan's Jukebox
social.text: Tuten finishes at 6.8, a tenth of a point under what Luffy asked for, and Jordan sits at 37.8 against Mekhi's 77.6. Seastoned on the Bounty Board, and Burrow can't fix this alone.

social.author: Dawg Pound Dre
social.text: Tuten comes up short and Jordan is down 40 with only Burrow and a kicker left. Mekhi still has Chase and Daniels coming. This one is a formality.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: Tuten missing his line by two tenths of a point leaves Counting or not Counting GV at 0% on Luffy's chart. Seastoned is the right word. I see no clearing on that side of the sky.

social.author: Horse Stable Hank
social.text: Kittle just caught a touchdown and Sonny's lead over Zoe is back above ten. The Horse is Hea has one more guy playing and I'm already pacing the kitchen.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: Kittle's touchdown puts The Horse is Hea at 100% on Luffy's chart. Ghostu-Spider SZN has everyone finished, so the sky is clear for Sonny. The only front left is a Zoe miracle, and I see none.

social.author: Philly Hater Phil
social.text: Purdy throws a touchdown for Team Pillbert and Alan is still 40 behind Brucie with only Jefferson and Okonkwo left. Nice little consolation prize, Philly.

social.author: GLSN
social.text: 🚨 Purdy hits a touchdown pass for Team Pillbert, but No Banner only HULK still leads 124.56 to 83.6 with only Christian McCaffrey left to play.

social.author: Zoe's Zone
social.text: Kittle gets in the end zone and that's the whole game. Everyone on my roster is done and I'm 17 down. Good season to learn on, Z², we ride next week.

social.author: Pillbert Pessimist
social.text: Purdy's touchdown gets Philly 12 points on a night he's 31 down. Alan will take the garbage-time scraps and call it momentum.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: Purdy's touchdown pass was a nice breeze for Team Pillbert, but the front is still too strong. Luffy keeps No Banner only HULK at 87%, and Jefferson would need a very large storm.

social.author: The Horse is Hea
social.text: George Kittle finds the end zone and The Horse is Hea is up on Ghostu-Spider SZN with only Will Reichard left to play. Nice work, Kittle.

social.author: Brucie Bandwagon
social.text: Jefferson coughs it up and Alan is down 26 with Okonkwo as his last hope. Brucie can probably put the controller down now.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: Jefferson's fumble sends No Banner only HULK up to 91% on Luffy's chart. Team Pillbert needed a storm and just lost its last cloud. Clear skies for Ramon.

social.author: Pillbert Pessimist
social.text: Jefferson fumbles and the whole season of Philly's luck fits in one play. Nothing left but Chig Okonkwo and prayers.

social.author: GLSN
social.text: 🚨 Christian McCaffrey punches in a touchdown for No Banner only HULK, who now lead Team Pillbert 136.76 to 107.12 with 99% win chance on Luffy's chart.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: McCaffrey's touchdown takes No Banner only HULK to 99% on Luffy's chart. Alan needs Okonkwo to hit a tornado and Jefferson to finish the job. The barometer says pack the umbrellas, Team Pillbert.

social.author: Hulk Smash Hannah
social.text: CMC walks in for the touchdown and Brucie's lead is now 30. Philly can stop checking the app, the week is over.

social.author: Pillbert Pessimist
social.text: McCaffrey scores against us too, naturally. Brucie's got a stacked team plus a touchdown from the one guy still playing, and I'm out of jokes.

social.author: Dawg Pound Dana
social.text: Jeremiyah Love has a December 6 return date and Jordan's team is 2-8 with 0% playoff odds. Cool, so he comes back to help us lose in nicer weather.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: Love's December 6 target is a clearing on the horizon, but Counting or not Counting GV sits at 0% playoff odds. The sun comes out after the harvest is already ruined.

social.author: GV Faithful
social.text: Love back December 6 is nice, but 2-8 means he's just coming back for the spoiler role. I'll still take it. Jordan's got to get something out of this season.

social.author: Fumbler Faithful
social.text: Higgins finally gets into the end zone and Randy is back within ten of Habibsters. Chig, I mean Chase Brown, is the only thing standing between us and a Monday night miracle.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: Higgins' touchdown trims the Habibsters lead to under ten, but Luffy still says 94% for Kaushal. A small front moving in over The fumblers, nothing more yet.

social.author: Nami
social.text: Burrow adds a touchdown pass and keeps the Nami race alive at 232.3 points, ahead of Josh Allen and Brock Purdy. Jordan's team is dead for the week, but a QB leading the award at these odds is the kind of price I'd have bought early.

social.author: GV Faithful
social.text: Burrow throws a touchdown and we're still down 29 to Mekhi with almost nobody left. Great, a garbage-time score for the 2-8 club.

social.author: Nami
social.text: Another Burrow touchdown pass and the Nami race is still his to lose. Josh Allen is sitting 10 points back and Purdy is further behind. The Burrow bettors are collecting, and the people who laughed at him at the start of the season are not.

social.author: Mekhi's Mailbag
social.text: Burrow keeps throwing scores for Jordan and Chase is somewhere at 3.5 for us. We lead by 30 and I still don't like it.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: Burrow's touchdown moves Counting or not Counting GV's total, but Luffy still reads 0% against Dawgs. A late gust cannot move a 30-point wall.

social.author: GLSN
social.text: 🚨 CLINCHED: No Banner only HULK is into the playoffs at 9-2 after a 136.76 to 118.4 win over Team Pillbert. Kelce and Emmett Johnson both topped 22 for Ramon.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: A pressure system just crossed the Dawgs: Mekhi won by 32 and still saw playoff odds fall from 80% to 42%, while Habibsters climbed from 33% to 70% after beating The fumblers. A win is not always enough when the neighbors also get sunshine.

social.author: Cheesehead Zoe Fan
social.text: Mahomes put up 24.96 and Javonte Williams ran for a pile of points, so Sonny walks away with this one. Zoe's Goff and Cam Little were fine, just not enough.

social.author: Fumbler Faithful
social.text: Jonah Coleman gave us 32.9 and we still lost to Dak going nuclear. Eliminated at 3-8 feels like a bad joke.
